examples.name: Sample — health-workforce-2024_p46
paragraphs: One series, twelve bars. Three bars print their number (43, 22, 5) and are copied exactly; the other nine are estimates against the 5-unit grid, most on or near a gridline (tolerance 0.05), the small Software developers bar harder to judge (0.1). Doctors stays 5 although its bar top measures a touch lower. The red EU average bar is an ordinary row: highlighting is styling, not structure. The single series has no printed name, so its column is headed by the value-axis title.

examples.name: Sample — bars drawn in perspective
paragraphs: Two 3-D bar charts with no printed values. Each bar has a front top edge and a back top edge at different heights. The axis ticks and the baseline sit on the front plane, so the front top edge is the value-bearing edge; every value below is an estimate, read to two significant figures on the first chart and to a tenth of a percent on the second. The tick labels print 1.200 and 12.00%, but an estimate is not written to that precision. The paragraphs between and around the charts are elided.
